name: Kuroshitsuji Movie: Book of the Atlantic
name_english: Black Butler: Book of the Atlantic
name_romanji: Black Butler: Book of the Atlantic
original_title: 黒執事 Book of the Atlantic
description: Ciel learns of a "Aurora Society", that is rumored to be researching how to bring the dead back to life. Their next meeting is scheduled to be conducted on the ship Campania, voyaging across the Atlantic Ocean. Much to Ciel's dismay, Elizabeth "Lizzy" Midford, is taking the same ship, thus leaving him with no choice but to get aboard as well.
